resources.string: Strict Mode — route Internet HTTP/WebSocket traffic through Tor only
Enter a valid port from 1 to 65535.

Requires a separate Tor service such as Orbot running on this device. Default SOCKS port is 9050. Strict Mode routes shared OkHttp traffic in RELYRA (Nostr relays and Blossom transfers) through 127.0.0.1 and never falls back to a direct Internet connection if Tor is unavailable. Local Bluetooth/Wi-Fi Direct/LAN links are separate. The internal WebView browser is blocked while Strict Mode is on because it does not use this SOCKS client.
Strict routing is configured. This does not confirm that Tor is running; test a relay after starting your Tor service.
Tor routing is off. Internet connections use the normal Android network route.
The internal browser is paused while Tor Strict Mode is enabled. The WebView does not use the RELYRA SOCKS proxy, so opening a page here could bypass Tor. Turn Strict Mode off to use this browser.
